ns2:course.label: Medieval Latin
ns2:course.description: Literary and historical texts in prose and poetry will be read in the original; the course will also cover patristic writings. Same as MDVL 460. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Two years of college Latin or consent of instructor.
